text_block_list.text: ...If I am to offer it up, it must be supreme.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (She really doesn't seem satisfied with the result.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A cold gaze urges me to speak
if I have something to say.
Now, what should I do—"
choice_data_list: Still, that wasn't a bad run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yet it is a diamond
marred by flaws.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Are you really satisfied
with just that much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If I am to offer it,
it must be pure, clear... and perfect."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise—...
it could not be called love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: Of course! My love for racing hasn't changed a bit.
